verdict.rationale: Termius is a cross-platform SSH client with mobile apps and some AI features, so running AI agents from a phone is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence shows it analyzing pull requests or suggesting code improvements. Its only documented AI capability is converting plain-language descriptions into shell commands, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit. Using an external agent over an SSH session would be a user-side workaround, not a Termius capability.
